Task.title: Task
Task.description: A prioritized to-do task item with deadline, importance, effort, and synchronization metadata

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the task

estimatedEffortMinutes.description: Estimated time to complete in minutes

dueDate.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds for task deadline, or 0 if none

completed.description: Whether the task has been completed

category.description: Category tag e.g. Work, Personal, Health, Study

priorityScore.description: Calculated intelligent priority score based on deadline urgency, importance, and effort

notificationEnabled.description: Whether smart reminder notifications are enabled for this task

createdAt.description: Timestamp when task was created; write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when task was last modified; write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/tasks/{taskId}.description: User to-do tasks collection partitioned by user ownership
